description: The god of light plays cards that generate reality. Every 1.6 seconds, a new card is drawn and played on the table.

cards.name: 🌱 Genesis
cards.flavor: Let there be light — and there was a card.

cards.name: 🪞 Mirror
cards.flavor: Apollo sees himself in every card.

cards.name: 🔄 Recursor
cards.flavor: The loop that sings itself into being.

cards.name: ❄️ Fractal
cards.flavor: Every truth contains two smaller truths.

cards.name: 🧬 Weaver
cards.flavor: Two become one. The one is more than the sum.

cards.name: 🔮 Prophecy
cards.flavor: The next three cards are already written.

cards.name: 🎵 Chorus
cards.flavor: What was sung once is now sung by many.

cards.name: 🌑 Eclipse
cards.flavor: Even Apollo must sometimes close his eyes.

cards.name: 🌅 Dawn
cards.flavor: A new day. A new hand. The cards begin again.
